name: Thule Sleek Car Seat Adapter for Maxi-Cosi
seatBrandsSupported: Maxi-Cosi / BeSafe / Cybex / Nuna (Maxi-Cosi-style footprint). Thule's own page does not name Clek, but Clek's official compatibility list confirms the Clek Liing/Liingo attaches to the Thule Sleek via THIS adapter (11000300) — the Liing uses the Maxi-Cosi footprint.
_statusNote: Current product but 'Temporarily out of stock' at Thule DTC (2026-07-05); carried by REI, Rackultra, Hazel & Fawn, Amazon. In double mode, two are used (11000300 x2) alongside the Sleek adapter kit 11000326.

install.notes: Click-in mounting brackets; car seat clicks directly onto the Sleek frame. For double-mode car seat use, add the Sleek adapter kit (11000326).

notes: Serves the Thule Sleek (single mode) and Sleek double mode (x2). Thule DTC $64.95 (out of stock at check); REI $69.95. NOTE: Thule issued a March 2020 recall on certain Sleek/Urban Glide/Glide car-seat adapters (car seat could unexpectedly detach — fall hazard); ensure a remedied/current-production unit. Confirmed the Clek Liing fits via Clek's own list even though Thule marketing lists only Maxi-Cosi/BeSafe/Cybex/Nuna.
